operating_notes.text: Allotted ₹200 Cr secured NCDs at 8.16% p.a. coupon on April 27, 2026, maturing February 14, 2029.

CRISIL's 11 May 2026 letter reaffirmed or assigned ratings on ₹1,05,100 Cr of instruments, including ₹81,200 Cr of NCDs at Crisil AAA/Stable and ₹11,900 Cr of commercial paper at Crisil A1+.

timeline.summary: Allotted ₹200 Cr secured redeemable NCDs at 8.16% coupon maturing February 14, 2029.
Aditya Birla Capital allotted ₹125 Cr of 10-year subordinated NCDs at 8.0668% coupon maturing April 30, 2036.
Aditya Birla Capital reported Q4FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹1,124 Cr, up 30% YoY, with total lending portfolio crossing ₹2.07 lakh Cr.
Aditya Birla Capital presented its FY26 financial results, highlighting a 14% increase in revenue to ₹53,871 Cr and a 21% growth in PAT to ₹3,797 Cr.
Aditya Birla Capital Limited shared the audio recording of its conference call on audited financial results (standalone and consolidated) for Q4FY26 and FY26 on 04 May 2026 via its website.
CRISIL reaffirmed ratings on ₹95,100 Cr debt/CP lines and assigned AAA/AA+ to ₹5,000 Cr new sub-debt and perpetual bonds.
Aditya Birla Capital allotted ₹728 Cr of secured NCDs across two tranches on May 14, 2026.
Aditya Birla Capital received an income-tax demand notice of ₹194.54 Cr for AY2025-26 due to unmigrated tax credits from the amalgamated subsidiary ABFL.
Aditya Birla Capital received RBI registration to carry on the business of factoring.
Aditya Birla Capital's board approved a ₹4,000 Cr preferential equity issue to Grasim Industries, Suryaja Investments, and IFC.
Aditya Birla Capital set June 12, 2026 as the EGM date for shareholder approval of its ₹4,000 Cr preferential issue at ₹356.02 a share to Grasim, Suryaja and IFC.
Grasim Industries Limited, as promoter of Aditya Birla Capital Limited, declared on April 7, 2026, no new encumbrances were made by promoters/PAC beyond those disclosed for FY2025-26.
Aditya Birla Capital Limited participated in Analyst/Institutional Investor Meet on 03 June 2026 in Mumbai with 20 funds/investors.
Aditya Birla Capital Limited participated in Analyst/Institutional Investor Meetings with Goldman Sachs, Dymon Asia, WhiteOak Capital, ICICI, Bandhan Mutual Fund on 08 June 2026 in Mumbai.
Aditya Birla Capital submitted updated fully diluted shareholding disclosures for its ₹4,000 Cr preferential issue.
2026-08-06: Transcript of Q1FY26 results conference call made available on company website
2026-10-15: Allotted ₹400 Cr of secured, rated, listed NCDs on private placement, redeemable September 15, 2028.
